svg.title: How PrefillAdder admits requests
svg.desc: 3 · Admit waiting requests while they fit
svg.text: 3 · Admit waiting requests while they fit
KV pool slots of one GPU · page_size 1
A waiting request costs its uncached prompt tokens + min(max_new_tokens, 4096).
X fits and joins the prefill batch · Y does not fit and waits for the next round.
